title: Demo competition_ranks port is faithful (verified line-for-line) but its tie/None-tail/offset semantics are unpinned on the client side
detail: Divergence risk the lens asked about: the subtle half of the port (shared ranks, tie-count jumps, unscored tail) has no client-side pin, so a future edit to the demo copy silently diverges from the server original. Both sides already import shared/leaderboard (application_list_handler.gleam:15, client/src/helpers/leaderboard.gleam:6), so a shared home exists.
recommended_fix: Add a 3-case client unit test on demo_store.competition_ranks mirroring the server's tie/unscored-tail/offset cases, or hoist the pure function into shared/leaderboard and have both sides call it.

title: Demo analysis narratives are now hand-synced in three places across the client/server boundary with no parity pin
evidence: client/src/demo/demo_store.gleam:259 and server/src/demo/pdf_prebake.gleam:447 carry the byte-identical flags JSON: "[{"label":"Rent sits at 72% of stated income - borderline","severity":"amber","category":"income_affordability"},{"label":"Landlord reference still awaiting callback","severity":"amber","category":"reference_verification"},{"label":"Employment tenure of 1 year - below the two-year stability threshold","severity":"amber","category":"employment_stability"},{"label":"No bank statements uploaded to corroborate the stated income","severity":"amber","category":"application_completeness"}]" — and the same facts are echoed a third time in server/src/demo/pdf_report_data.gleam (e.g. sara_parts insight: "the ratio is 72% — well above the typical band").
detail: Pre-existing demo pattern (screen fixtures vs prebake payloads), but this diff enlarges the synced surface and adds pdf_report_data as a third copy, while the PR's stated goal is screen↔PDF consistency — which now rests entirely on manual sync. The new pdf_report_data_test pins extras sections, not equality with demo_store flags/positives, so a future fixture edit on one side contradicts the baked PDFs undetected.
recommended_fix: Accept the duality explicitly (demo canon) but add a lightweight parity check — e.g. a scripts/ lint asserting the flags/positives JSON strings match between demo_store.gleam and pdf_prebake.gleam, in the spirit of lint_demo_network.py.

title: pub fn payloads() widened with no external consumer; the new pin test hardcodes the same 8 applicant ids instead
evidence:
server/src/demo/pdf_prebake.gleam:325: "pub fn payloads() -> List(ReportPayload) {" — its only call site is inside the same module (line 743: "list.map(payloads(), fn(p) {"). Meanwhile server/test/demo/pdf_report_data_test.gleam:19-29 duplicates the id list: "const all_applicants: List(String) = [
  "a-aoife",
  "a-conor",
  "a-marta",
  "a-declan",
  "a-sara",
  "a-tom",
  "a-grainne",
  "a-liam",
]".
detail: The pub widening (made in this diff; ReportPayload was already pub) has exactly no consumer, and the natural consumer — the new test — instead hardcodes the applicant list. A 9th demo applicant added to payloads() would bake an unpinned PDF silently.
recommended_fix: Have the test iterate pdf_prebake.payloads() (reading application_id off each payload) instead of the hardcoded const — justifies the pub and closes the drift gap — or drop the pub.
